title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Cardholder Share of Special Order Delivery Charges on Deposit Programs
content:
Ridgeline Consumer Credit cardholders pay a reduced home delivery charge on a delivered Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent, by a cardholder share that depends on the account's age.

**Clause.** The cardholder share depends on the customer's Ridgeline Consumer Credit account: an active account opened at least 60 whole months before today gives a cardholder share of 0.85; an active account opened fewer than 60 whole months before today gives 0.9; otherwise the cardholder share is 1.

The delivery charge billed is multiplied by the cardholder share before its single rounding to the nearest cent; the share itself is never rounded.

## Records read

The customer's Ridgeline Consumer Credit account record: its status and the date it was opened.

## Share by account record

| Consumer Credit account status | Whole months from opening to today | Cardholder share |
|---|---|---|
| active | 60 or more | 0.85 |
| active | fewer than 60 | 0.9 |
| applied, suspended, closed, declined or charged off | any | 1 |
| no Consumer Credit account | — | 1 |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical today of 8 October 2026, active account, charge of 99.00 before the share)

| Opened | Whole months | Share | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8 October 2021 | 60 | 0.85 | 84.15 |
| 9 October 2021 | 59 | 0.9 | 89.10 |
